findings.issue: PYTHON_VERSION '3.11' floats to current patch; python job caches target/ which contains the venv (target/jev-python-venv), so a restored venv can point at a vanished interpreter after a patch bump; venv created without --clear; pip pins only top-level maturin/pytest (pluggy, iniconfig, packaging, pygments float).
findings.recommendation: Put the venv outside target/ ($RUNNER_TEMP) or venv --clear; pin exact Python patch; hash-pinned constraints file for transitives.

findings.issue: Header claims 'no step retries' but CARGO_NET_RETRY=2 configures network fetch retries.
findings.recommendation: Set CARGO_NET_RETRY=0 or correct header + ci.md to say bounded network-fetch retries only.

findings.issue: doc job continue-on-error reports green while failing; hides regressions until flag removed; nothing enforces removal.
findings.recommendation: Fix the 11 warnings and drop the flag (QA-005), or make it a non-required job that reports its real status.

notes: All 24 uses: SHA-pinned; runners exact; tools exact; Cargo.lock committed; every step/job has timeout-minutes; fail-fast false; per-PR concurrency; separate jobs/checkouts so no races; pytest isolated; coverage order-independent; Windows shell handling looks right (read from YAML only — did not see the run)
